significance: The highest-set of the temples around Prambanan, standing at about 410 m on a hill some 4 km from Ratu Boko. Its main shrine holds a large linga and yoni wreathed by a naga, read as the union of Shiva and Parvati, while three smaller perwara facing east honour the Trimurti of Brahma, Vishnu and Shiva.
